Belle Tout Lighthouse B&B - Britain's Most Dramatic Stay
Skip to content
Britain's Most Dramatic Stay
Book Now
Stay Inside Britain’s Most Dramatic Lighthouse Guest House
A unique coastal escape on the cliffs of Beachy Head with panoramic sea views, unforgettable sunsets and only six exclusive rooms.
Over 800 Five Star Trip Advisor Reviews
Trip Advisor Travellers' Choice Award Winner 2026
Adult Only Venue (16 yrs plus)
Delicious Home-Cooked Breakfast
One of the most unforgettable overnight stays in Britain
Breath-taking sea and countryside views
Perched on the cliffs of Beachy Head, Belle Tout Lighthouse is one of Britain’s most unique coastal stays. Built in 1832 and beautifully restored, this iconic lighthouse combines rich history with unforgettable comfort, offering panoramic views of the English Channel, the Seven Sisters, and rolling countryside. From cosy fires and character-filled rooms to spectacular sunsets in the Lantern Room, Belle Tout is more than a place to stay,  it’s an experience designed to help you slow down, unwind, and reconnect with the beauty of the coast.
Why Belle Tout
Britain’s Most Dramatic Stay
Wake up surrounded by panoramic sea views, towering cliffs, and the unforgettable beauty of Beachy Head and the Seven Sisters.
A Lighthouse Steeped in History
Built in 1832, Belle Tout combines heritage, character, and timeless charm in one of the UK’s most iconic buildings.
Peaceful, Restorative Escapes
Far from the noise of everyday life, Belle Tout is a place to slow down, switch off, and reconnect with nature.
Unforgettable Sunsets & Atmosphere
From cosy fires in winter to golden sunsets in the Lantern Room, every stay is filled with moments you’ll remember long after you leave.

"So much to see and do; the perfect place to stay."
Beachy Head
The Tiger Inn is a five minute drive from Belle Tout Lighthouse. Expect fine food, great ales and a warm welcome in this idyllic country pub.
See more of Beachy Head with guided walks to explore the area and it's history.
Weddings and Events  amid the splendour and beauty of Birling Manor and Bardolphs Hall.
Find out more at  www.beachyhead.org.uk
Birling Gap
Birling Gap provides a point of entry for delightful walks. The beach below is ideal for seaside picnics with its rock pools and areas of pebbles and sand. It is a great example of a marine nature reserve. Find out more on the Birling Gap website.
There is a National Trust café and the shop sells locally sourced items, seaside goods and traditional favourites from fishing nets to fleeces, books to buckets and spades.
Find out more at the  National Trust  web site.
Seven Sisters National Park
In 2016, the South Downs National Park was designated as an International Dark Skies Reserve. As one of 10 ‘Dark Skies Discovery Sites’ this is a great place to view the night sky.
On a clear night from October through to March, it’s possible to catch glimpses of the Milky Way as it rises above the famous chalk cliffs.
Cukmere Haven
Explore the spectacular meanders of the Cuckmere River on foot, by bicycle or by canoe. The Seven Sisters Visitor Centre at Exceat is situated in an 18th century barn, with gifts, maps, books, local crafts and local produce to take home as souvenirs of your visit.
Exceat Farmhouse Restaurant provides home baked fare of traditional and continental cuisine.
East Dean
The perfect place to visit if you’re walking the South Downs Way. Home to The Tiger Inn, the flint Church of St Simon and St Jude still preserves its Saxon tower, along with Norman additions and an unusual tapsel gate (unique to Sussex).
Eastbourne - town of culture
Our neighbour, Eastbourne, has a vibrant cultural scene anchored by the contemporary Towner Gallery Eastbourne , which showcases modern British art and hosts major exhibitions and events.
The Congress Theatre and Devonshire Quarter bring a year-round programme of theatre, music, and festivals giving the town a lively, creative atmosphere.
A lovely beach and pier and plenty of fantastic restaurants and bars, provide a great day and evening out.

Accommodation | Belle Tout Lighthouse
Skip to content
Belle Tout Lighthouse Bed & Breakfast
Book Now
Belle Tout Lighthouse is a warm, homely Bed and Breakfast where guests can truly switch off, surrounded by comfort, character, and sweeping coastal views.
Time seems to slow here, creating a deeply emotional, one-of-a-kind escape where every stay feels personal, peaceful, and quietly unforgettable.
Our Residents' Lounge offers a tranquil space to relax and unwind, with a roaring fire in winter months. Escape to the Lantern Room to watch the stunning sunsets; each one entirely unique, painting the sky in ever-changing colours that make every evening feel like a moment to pause, reflect, and simply take it all in. Our Guests' Office is a quiet place to work remotely, with superfast Wi-Fi.  The Guest Lounge, Guest Office and Lantern Room are open all day for all guests. A guests' fridge is provided to chill your own beverages.
Our bedrooms have an en-suite shower room ('Old England' is the only en-suite with a bath), and enjoy amazing views of the sea, the Seven Sisters, Beachy Head or The South Downs.  The Keeper's Loft bedroom is the only room situated in the original granite Lighthouse, and is very popular. It does, however, not suit everyone due to the steep ladder, low ceiling above the bed and the mezzanine double bed. Please familiarise yourself with the Keeper's Loft before making your reservation.  We have one Twin Bedroom, 'South Downs', which can also be configured as a super-king.
All bedrooms include complimentary tea and coffee making facilities, hair dryers and safe.

Room Rates | Belle Tout Lighthouse
Skip to content
Belle Tout Lighthouse B&B Room Rates
Each room at Belle Tout Lighthouse is equipped with the same high-quality facilities. All rooms are en-suite. Guests can relax in the residents’ lounge, which offers beautiful sea views, or enjoy the Lantern Room, boasting a breathtaking 360-degree panorama across the South Downs, with stunning views of the Seven Sisters in one direction and Beachy Head lighthouse in the other. We have a dedicated Guest’s Office with fast WiFi for those needing to work remotely during their stay.
Each room sleeps up to two guests. Rates are per room, per night, and include a delicious home cooked breakfast for two people. Prices include VAT at 20%. Single Occupancy discounts apply: ‘Captain’s Cabin’ and ‘Keeper’s Loft’ 30% off, all other rooms 15% off. ‘South Downs’ can be configured as a Twin Room.

Information & Booking Terms
Booking Terms
The Minimum age for our guests is 16 years or above. All guests under the age of 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Pets are not permitted and we cannot accommodate Hen or Stag parties.
Single Occupancy . 30% discount given off room rate for single occupancy in Captain’s Cabin and Keeper’s Loft and 15% off all other rooms.
Payment Policy . 50% deposit is charged at the time of your reservation. The remaining balance will be payable on departure. (If you would like to make other payment arrangements for the balance, please notify us prior to your arrival date).
Cancellation Policy . Cancellations made more than 14 days before your arrival will receive a refund less £25 processing fee. For cancellations made within the 14 day period, we will do our best to re-book your room. If we cannot, you will be responsible for the full amount of your reservation. ‘No shows’ will be charged the full price.
Amending your booking . You may change the date of your booking if the date of your stay is not within the next 14 days. We charge a £25 admin fee to amend a booking. If your stay is within 14 days, we are unable to make changes.
Keeper's Loft - Please ensure that you fully understand the restrictions of this unique room as we may not be able to offer you an alternative bedroom upon arrival if you decide not to occupy the room; and a refund will not be given.
We will email you prior to arrival with all the information you will need for your arrival, check in and stay with us. Please let us know if advance of any specific requirements (e.g. Dietary requests).
All 3rd party bookings must be paid in full at time of booking.
We accept payment by VISA, MasterCard, Cheque or cash.
We do not accept American Express.
The Lighthouse is completely Non Smoking
Information correct as of 24th April 2026. E&OE

To purchase Belle Tout Lighthouse B&B gift vouchers please call 01323 423185.
Gift Vouchers cannot be redeemed between 17th Dec 2026 and 8th Jan 2027 when the Lighthouse is closed.
